prompt:
Locked-off camera, framing holds. From the first instant the man raps with the microphone held tight to his masked mouth. On the first beat his spread glove snaps shut into a fist; on the next it bursts open again, a magician's flash; then the open hand sweeps slowly across in front of his chest, like a conjuror waving a cloth, and flings wide again. Knees bounce on every beat, torso dipping towards the lens. He keeps the microphone the whole time. The dancers keep kicking; the stagehand stands bored, holding his rope. Mask and gloves stay exactly as they are. SFX: tap of heels, cloth.

Thanks.
